The '''Imperial Knights quarters''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] and included a practice room where members of the [[Imperial Knight]]s could [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|spar]] with one another. Around [[137 ABY]], a sparring match occurred in the practice room between the Imperial Knights [[Ganner Krieg]] and [[Azlyn Rae]] under the direction of [[Imperial Knight#Mastery|Master]] [[Treis Sinde]]. It was observed by several other members of the order, including [[Roan Fel]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] that the Imperial Knights served.<ref name="vongspawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Knights quarters appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 43|forty-third]] issue of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="vongspawn" /> and published on [[December 23]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54415/star_wars_legacy_2006_43|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #43}}</ref>
